subject_rule: Limited: the call funds only ten named Belgian training courses (one specialised bachelor, eight specialised or advanced masters and one continuing-training certificate); the applicant chooses one, and each course sets its own admission titles.

programmes.name: Specialised Bachelor in Digital Integrated Supply Chain (DISC) (Bachelier de spécialisation en Digital Integrated Supply Chain)
programmes.institution: Haute École EPHEC (lead institution), with École Supérieure d'Enseignement pour Adultes EPHEC (partner, joint diploma)
programmes.detail: 60 ECTS in 12 months, French, 10 scholarships; field group: economics and management, computer science

programmes.name: Specialised Master in Human Rights (Master de spécialisation en droits humains)
programmes.institution: Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain); Université de Namur (UNamur); Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB)
programmes.detail: One academic year, French (one elective in English), 11 scholarships; field group: law and human rights

programmes.name: Specialised Master in Integrated Management of Health Risks (Master de spécialisation en gestion intégrée des risques sanitaires)
programmes.institution: Université de Liège (ULiège); Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB); Université de Namur (UNamur)
programmes.detail: One academic year, French, 10 scholarships; field group: One Health, health sciences, veterinary sciences, agronomic and environmental sciences, human and social sciences

programmes.name: Specialised Master in International and Development Economics (SMIDE)
programmes.institution: Université de Namur (UNamur); Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain)
programmes.detail: One academic year, English, 10 scholarships; field group: economics

programmes.name: Advanced Master in Microfinance
programmes.institution: Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB); Université de Mons (UMONS)
programmes.detail: One academic year, English, 10 scholarships; field group: economics, finance, development cooperation

programmes.name: Specialised Master in Public Health Sciences: analysis and evaluation of international health policies, programmes and systems (Master de spécialisation en sciences de la santé publique)
programmes.institution: Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain, coordinating); Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB)
programmes.detail: One academic year, 60 credits, French with passive English, 10 scholarships; field group: public health

programmes.name: Specialised Master in Food Chain Safety Management (MASCA) (Master de spécialisation en management de la sécurité de la chaîne alimentaire)
programmes.institution: Université de Liège (ULiège), Faculty of Veterinary Medicine; Haute École de la Province de Liège
programmes.detail: One academic year, French, 10 scholarships; field group: food safety, veterinary and life sciences

programmes.name: Specialised Master in Preventive Conservation and Collection Management (Master de spécialisation en conservation préventive et gestion des collections)
programmes.institution: ENSAV La Cambre - École nationale supérieure des Arts visuels (coordinating); Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB) (joint diploma)
programmes.detail: One academic year, French, 10 scholarships; field group: heritage, conservation-restoration, art history, museology

programmes.name: Specialised Master in Risk and Disaster Management in the Anthropocene (Master de spécialisation en gestion des risques et des catastrophes à l'ère de l'Anthropocène)
programmes.institution: Université de Liège (ULiège); Université de Namur (UNamur)
programmes.detail: One academic year, mainly French (some seminars in English), 10 scholarships; field group: disaster risk management

programmes.name: Certificate in Cybersecurity Operations and Risk Governance (Certificat en opérations de cybersécurité et gouvernance des risques)
programmes.institution: Haute École Provinciale de Hainaut-Condorcet (HEPH-Condorcet), EeCampus Froyennes, joint diploma with Haute École en Hainaut (HEH)
programmes.detail: Continuing training, 6 months (140 hours, 15 ECTS) from January 2028, including one month in Belgium (April 2028), French with technical terms in English, 12 scholarships; field group: information technology and cybersecurity

notes: Recorded 1 bachelor, 8 master and 1 certificate (diploma) course = 10, which is the full list on the call page (the page states ten courses).

Cybersecurity certificate: the first pass could not find its institution; the course's own presentation document names Haute École Provinciale de Hainaut-Condorcet (EeCampus Froyennes) with Haute École en Hainaut, French, 12 scholarships (not 10), starting January 2028. Admission: bachelor, master or engineering degree in information technology, computer science, telecommunications or a related field, OR at least 5 years of IT or cybersecurity experience.

Previous degrees (admission titles) named by the course documents, kept here because they are not courses of the scholarship. Digital Integrated Supply Chain accepts these titles from domain 9 (economics and management): Bachelier en comptabilité; Bachelier en international business (commerce extérieur); Bachelier : conseiller en développement durable; Bachelier en coopération internationale; Bachelier en e-business; Bachelier en gestion hôtelière, orientation management; Bachelier en management de la logistique; Bachelier en management du tourisme et des loisirs; Bachelier en marketing; Bachelier en relations publiques; Bachelier en sciences administratives et gestion publique; Master : ingénieur de gestion; Master en sciences économiques, orientation générale; Master en sciences économiques, orientation économétrie; Master en sciences de gestion; Master en gestion culturelle; Master en sales management; Master en sciences commerciales; Master en gestion publique; Master en facility management; Master : ingénieur commercial; Master en gestion de l'entreprise; and from domain 17 (computer science): Bachelier en informatique : orientation développement d'applications (formerly Bachelier en informatique de gestion). Others by recognition of experience (VAE, at least 5 years).

Food Chain Safety Management gives direct access to holders of: Master en Médecine vétérinaire; Master en Médecine; Master en Sciences pharmaceutiques; Master en Sciences biomédicales; Master Bioingénieur en chimie et bioindustries; Master Bioingénieur en sciences agronomiques; Master en Biologie des organismes et écologie; Master en Biochimie, biologie moléculaire et cellulaire; Master en Sciences chimiques; Master en Management de l'innovation et de la conception des aliments; Master en Sciences de l'ingénieur industriel, orientation agronomie; other profiles by jury decision.

Other courses name fields rather than titles: Human Rights (second-cycle degree in law of 120 credits, or a related field); Integrated Management of Health Risks (health sciences, veterinary sciences, agronomic and environmental sciences, human and social sciences; the list is not restricted); Public Health Sciences (master in health sciences, human and social sciences, economics and management, public health basics, 2 years of experience); Microfinance (second-cycle degree, mainly development cooperation, economics, agronomy, management or finance); SMIDE (degree after 5 years, or 4 years plus 2 years of experience, with a background in economics); Preventive Conservation (second-cycle degree in conservation-restoration, art history, archaeology, museology, heritage management or a field the jury finds relevant, plus 2 years in a heritage institution); Risk and Disaster Management (second-cycle degree in sciences, applied sciences, health sciences, economics and management, social and political sciences, European studies, public administration, agronomic sciences, communication sciences, or another degree the jury finds relevant).
The documents are headed with the 2027-2032 programme; the call itself (2027-2028 intake) is closed and the next call is expected in August 2027.
not_stated: Course lists (modules) of each course are not in the presentation documents for most courses; DISC and several others refer to the institution's own teaching profile.
